push.title: L 1-3 vs 217 Footy | You: 7.8
push.body:
PhogsToffees, a 7.8 against 217 Footy. A good honest shift, like a well-made chair.

THE GOOD
+ 6 shots at 217 Footy's goal. You kept the keeper busier than a one-man band.
+ On-ball actions 41, up from your usual 30. I'd put that on a billboard if I could afford one.
+ 5th straight match at 7.5 match rating. Quietly brilliant, and I noticed.
+ 1 key pass bumped you +0.1. Love it.
+ 3 goals conceded: +0.1. Nicely done.

THE BAD
- 1 goal from 5 on target. Let's sharpen this: Side-foot for accuracy inside the box; power is for outside it.
- Same finishing trouble for you and BellyTb1. Buddy up: square it when the keeper commits.
- Assists 0, down from your usual 1. Let's call that a lesson and not a trend.
- Tackles won 0, down from your usual 1. Tell you what: Track your runner all the way into the box. Most goals against come from late, unmarked runs.
- Your 3rd straight loss. Ain't no hiding from that one. Good. Now we learn from it.

Training-ground special: We're hitting the target, so now aim for the corners. Keepers love a shot down the middle.

PhogsToffees, my granddaddy told me this and now I'm telling you: There's no 'I' in team, but there's a 'me' if you scramble it. Don't scramble it.

Champions have off days too. - Coach Lasso

push.title: L 1-3 vs 217 Footy | You: 7.5
push.body:
BellyTb1, a 7.5 is above the line for a midfielder. Let's go hunting for the extra half point.

THE GOOD
+ 28 passes (up from your usual 15). You were everywhere except the parking lot.
+ Feeding PhogsToffees like that is a recipe I want to keep making.
+ Tackles won 2, up from your usual 1. You can build a whole match on that.
+ 1 key pass put +0.1 on the board for you.

THE BAD
- Only 2 tackles attempted. Habit to build: Second-ball awareness: after a header or clearance, be the first one to the loose ball. You know you can.
- 71% passing (20 of 28). Quick one: Before the killer ball, check: is my runner onside, moving, and unmarked? Two out of three isn't enough. Like riding a bike.
- 0 goals from 3 on target. Lesson of the day: Low shots across the keeper are the hardest to save and the easiest to tap in on the rebound.
- Funny how finishing snagged you and PhogsToffees both. Remedy: square it when the keeper commits.
- 3 goals conceded dropped you 0.1. Let's patch that.

Practice plan: When the ball is lost, the nearest player presses and everyone else closes the passing lanes.

Listen here, BellyTb1: Kindness costs nothing and wins locker rooms.

Hang in there; it's coming. - Coach Lasso
